'''Wu Yangjie''' ({{zh|s=吴养洁}}; born 1 January 1928) is a Chinese organic chemist and a professor at [[Zhengzhou University]]. He is an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

== Biography ==
Wu was born 1 January 1928 in [[Jinan]], [[Shandong]], Republic of China. He graduated from the Department of Chemistry of [[Fudan University]] in 1951, and was hired as a faculty member by the university. In September 1954, he began his graduate studies in the Department of Chemistry of the [[Moscow State University]], and earned his associate doctor degree (Ph.D. equivalent) in June 1958.<ref>{{Cite journal|url=http://www.cnki.com.cn/Article/CJFDTotal-YJHU201801001.htm|title=祝贺我国著名有机化学家、中国科学院院士吴养洁先生九十华诞|last=Ding|first=Kuiling|authorlink=Ding Kuiling|date=January 2018|journal=Chinese Journal of Organic Chemistry|issn=0253-2786|access-date=2019-02-09|archive-date=2019-02-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190209180605/http://www.cnki.com.cn/Article/CJFDTotal-YJHU201801001.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref>

After returning to China, Wu was assigned to the newly founded [[Zhengzhou University]] to help establish its chemistry department, where he worked for the rest of his career. He later served as chairman of the department and a doctoral advisor.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://news.sina.com.cn/w/2003-11-26/05461188703s.shtml|title=吴养洁院士简介|date=2003-11-26|website=Sina|access-date=2019-02-09}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://www5.zzu.edu.cn/hxxy/info/1033/2826.htm|title=吴养洁|website=Zhengzhou University|access-date=2019-02-09|archive-date=2019-02-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190209180227/http://www5.zzu.edu.cn/hxxy/info/1033/2826.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Wu published more than 160 research articles. He won a National Science Congress Award in 1978, and the Henan Science and Technology Progress Award (First Class) in 2001. He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 2003.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
